name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 2px solid #005FCC focus ring with a 3px outer glow to every interactive element that receives keyboard focus. This ensures clear visibility for users who rely on keyboard navigation, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements while keeping the ring visible against any background. The trade-off is a slight increase in visual noise for sighted keyboard users, but this is outweighed by the critical need for accessibility compliance and usability.

name: Reader
text: A 2px ring with 3px glow shrinks already-tight touch targets on mobile—users miss the element because the ring eats into the 44px minimum. Instead, use a 3px ring with a 2px outer glow; it’s visible but preserves tap size. Settle this by testing on a 320px viewport with 120% zoom—if the ring doesn’t clip the target, it’s acceptable.

name: Reader
text: A 3px ring with 2px glow still bleeds into the 44px touch target on high-contrast or zoomed mobile screens. Instead, use a 2px ring with a 1px outer glow—it meets WCAG contrast without sacrificing space. Settle this by testing on a 320px viewport at 150% zoom; if the ring remains visible and touch targets stay intact, lock the decision.
